ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The report is generated at the close of business on each day.
evidence_from_context: Glossary: 'report: Automated daily summary of processed transactions.'

Business rule BR-01: 'Each generated report must be delivered to the report archive within 5 minutes of generation; if delivery fails, the system must retry every 10 minutes for up to 2 hours before raising an alert to the operations team.'
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The glossary defines 'report' as an 'Automated daily summary of processed transactions', implying a daily generation. Business rule BR-01 specifies a 5-minute delivery timeframe, consistent with a close-of-business generation.
